Private cooking at a star level
Aug 2026 • Family
We had lunch one day and we liked it very much and it also tasted excellent. Since we wanted to take a cooking class, we asked about it and booked it immediately for 3 days later. 3,000,000 VND for 3 people, including a visit to the herb and vegetable garden, a tour of the market hall, and the local vegetable market. Very qualified tour guide. Afterwards, we went to the restaurant. On the 2nd floor, the three of us, along with our guide VUI and an assistant, prepared 3 dishes. Spring rolls, pancakes, fish in banana leaf with side dishes. Everything was super clean and highly professional. Would love to come back. That was private cooking at the highest level.
